CRIMEMIND — FINAL SYNTHETIC INVESTIGATION WORLD
================================================
Fictional case: The Meridian House Incident
Fictional city: Nandipur, India
Incident date: 18 August 2026

STORY
-----
Meridian House is a fictional mixed-use heritage property with offices, a guest
wing, courtyard, service entrance, parking and nearby commercial premises.

On the evening of 18 August 2026, the owner, Arvind Malhotra, hosted a private
business meeting and dinner. Several employees, contractors, guests, a former
business associate, tenants and service personnel were present or had legitimate
reasons to interact with the property.

At approximately 21:18, an east-office motion alert was recorded. A staff member
subsequently discovered the owner unconscious in the restricted office. Emergency
services were called and the victim was pronounced dead.

There is no single clean account of what happened. Witnesses disagree about
times and descriptions. One access reader intermittently failed. Vehicle records
are incomplete. Phone activity, financial records, location traces and access
records overlap in ways that require investigation.

CrimeMind must determine which facts are connected, which people are relevant,
which timelines contain meaningful gaps, and which evidence sources corroborate
one another.

CRITICAL RESEARCH DESIGN
------------------------
The ingestible world DOES NOT identify candidate classifications, offender classifications, offenders or conclusions.
All people are ordinary entities with legitimate roles and relationships.
CrimeMind must discover candidates itself.

The evidence is deliberately heterogeneous and imperfect. The structured database
is not supplied as the conclusion; the ingestion layer must extract and normalize the
raw evidence first.

Formats included:
PDF/DOCX/TXT/CSV/XLSX/JSON/XML/HTML/EML/VCF/ICS/LOG/JPG/PNG/WAV/SRT/KML/
GeoJSON/SQL plus an intentionally empty MP4 CCTV input folder.

The 40 predefined investigation questions remain the fixed analytical question
set. This world introduces no replacement question set.

PIPELINE
--------
Raw evidence -> ingestion/extraction -> normalization -> PostgreSQL/PostGIS
-> reusable SQL modules -> correlation engine -> evidence packets
-> AI synthesis -> traceable investigator report.

The LLM explains evidence-supported conclusions; it does not invent facts.
